description: Plan weekly production across every stage of your plant. Production Plan builds a shift-by-shift schedule for each production area from your products, weekly goals, deliveries, machine cycle times and buffer levels, and shows the whole material flow on a pipeline map. FREE VERSION - BUILD A REAL SCHEDULE BEFORE YOU BUY No licence and no sign-up. Install the visual, bind your data and plan straight away, in Power BI Desktop and in the Power BI service alike: - Up to 3 production areas, each with up to 2 machines - The complete planning engine: shift schedule, products, cycle times, buffers, weekly goals, deliveries and product routing - Pull-through demand, so downstream goals drive what upstream areas must make - The Logistics page and every area's own plan page WHAT A LICENCE ADDS - Unlimited areas and machines - Gantt page - every product on a shift-by-shift timeline for the selected area - Pipeline Map - the whole production chain from above, with parallel branches and bypasses in one picture - Virtual machines - split one physical machine into separately planned, named lanes VIEWERS ARE ALWAYS FREE Only the person who edits the report needs a licence. Everyone who simply views the report sees the full, configured visual at no cost - which is what makes this practical for planning boards and shop-floor screens, where many people watch one report.
